originality.rationale: The precise new assertion classifies all signed minimizers in products of two or more cycles as a multivariate marginal polytope, including codimension and immediate appearance of negative coefficients above the critical attachment radius. General random-projection theorems establish extension existence, not this equality classification; one-cycle results do not imply arbitrary correlated joint solutions without new positivity and tensor-marginal arguments. The minimum norm alone is deliberately acknowledged as a symmetry corollary.

value.rationale: Solves a naturally motivated equality-classification problem for an unbounded family: exact optimum plus complete signed-coefficient rigidity, all correlated optimal couplings, an affine dimension growing with product size, and an immediate geometric change to signed full-dimensional optimizers. Distinguishes positive optimal random projections from merely bounded linear ones and yields concrete mixed-parity threshold examples. The value is not attributed to the symmetry-derived numeric optimum alone.
